constant_descriptions.compiler: The compiler used to generate the codec binaries

constant_descriptions.hardware: The hardware used to encode and decode the images

constant_descriptions.source_data_set: The origin of the images used as input

constant_descriptions.codec: Name of the codec used to generate this data

constant_descriptions.version: Version of the codec used to generate this data

constant_descriptions.time: Timestamp of when this data was generated

constant_descriptions.build_command: The command used to generate the codec binaries

constant_descriptions.encoding_cmd: The command used to encode the original image

constant_values: git clone -b v0.7.3 --depth 1 https://github.com/webmproject/codec-compare-gen.git ccgen && cmake -S ccgen -B ccgen/build -DCCGEN_ENABLE_AVIF=OFF -DCCGEN_ENABLE_JPEG=OFF -DCCGEN_ENABLE_WEBP=ON -DCCGEN_ENABLE_WEBPRS=ON -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++ && cmake --build ccgen/build --parallel

field_descriptions.width: Pixel columns in the image that was encoded

field_descriptions.height: Pixel rows in the image that was encoded

field_descriptions.depth: Bit depth of the image that was encoded

field_descriptions.frame_count: Number of frames in the image that was encoded

field_descriptions.encoded_size: Size of the encoded image file in bytes

field_descriptions.encoding_time: Encoding duration in seconds. Warning: Timings are environment-dependent and inaccurate.

field_descriptions.decoding_time: Decoding duration in seconds. Warning: Timings are environment-dependent and inaccurate.

field_descriptions.dec_time_no_col_conv: Decoding duration in seconds without color conversion. Warning: Only different from regular decoding for codecs without built-in conversion.

field_descriptions.psnr: Distortion metric Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (libwebp2 implementation). See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peak_signal-to-noise_ratio. Warning: There is no scientific consensus on which objective distortion metric to use.

field_descriptions.ssim: Distortion metric Structural Similarity Index Measure (libwebp2 implementation). See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Structural_similarity. Warning: There is no scientific consensus on which objective distortion metric to use.

field_descriptions.dssim: Distortion metric Structural Dissimilarity (kornelski implementation). See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Structural_similarity_index_measure#Structural_Dissimilarity. Warning: There is no scientific consensus on which objective distortion metric to use.

field_descriptions.butteraugli: Distortion metric Butteraugli (libjxl implementation). See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guetzli#Butteraugli. Warning: There is no scientific consensus on which objective distortion metric to use.

field_descriptions.ssimulacra: Distortion metric SSIMULACRA (libjxl implementation). See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Structural_similarity#SSIMULACRA. Warning: There is no scientific consensus on which objective distortion metric to use.

field_descriptions.ssimulacra2: Distortion metric SSIMULACRA2 (libjxl implementation). See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Structural_similarity#SSIMULACRA. Warning: There is no scientific consensus on which objective distortion metric to use.

field_descriptions.p3norm: Distortion metric P3-norm (libjxl implementation). See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Norm_(mathematics)#p-norm. Warning: There is no scientific consensus on which objective distortion metric to use.
